notes: Site is a Shopify storefront (clay-craft-india.myshopify.com), direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no blocking. Checked: header mega-menu / mobile menu-drawer HTML (full nav dump), the complete collections.json listing (54 collections, page2 empty confirming completeness), and the collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, same 54 handles) - none of the 54 collection titles/handles are bestseller/top-seller/popular/most-popular/customer-favorite/trending in any form (closest are 'sale', 'new-arrivals', 'under-199', 'under-500', all unrelated to bestseller merchandising). Also checked pages sitemap (23 static pages: about, policies, warranty, hotelware, etc.) - no bestseller page. Site search for 'bestseller' and 'popular' returned explicit 'no results' pages. Site search for 'best seller' (with space) did not show a 'no results' message but returned exactly one fuzzy false-positive PDP match (a Disney-branded coffee/tea mug set product page, matched on unrelated text, not a listing) - confirmed by opening the result and reading it, consistent with this site's known fuzzy-search behavior (prior Home-Decor pass found identical false-positive behavior for lamp/mirror/clock queries here). No genuine Bestsellers-type merchandising PLP exists on this site.
